The '''Skulljaw Grottoes''' was a location below the [[Daggersand Ridges]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> By [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Tsyr]] is killed during the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic arc [[Star Wars: Rite of Passage|Rite of Passage]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. Therefore the duel between Tsyr and Ma'kis'shaalas must have taken place before then.</ref> the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Tsyr]] fought against the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]] in along the Daggersand Ridges until Tsyr lost his footing and fell into the Skulljaw Grottoes below.<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skulljaw Grottoes were mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> in [[March]] [[2004]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=products/swrpgacc/888870000|text=Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds}}</ref>
